newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ARCON says results from new zone promising.
newsitem.headline: ARCON says results from new zone promising.

text.p: Irish exploration group ARCON International Resources Plc said on Wednesday it had achieved highly promising first drilling results from a new zone near Templetuohy Bog in the Irish midlands.
The company said in a statement that it also had further encouraging intersections from Templetuohy Bog itself.
"This area of mineralisation, first announced last September, continues to return good zinc-lead values," the company said.
ARCON said continued good values were encountered at its Galmoy lead-zinc mine in the Irish midlands.
The company said its ongoing exploration programme in the Galmoy District continued to yield very positive drilling results which exhibit good zinc values over economically mineable widths.

ARCON said it remained committed to achieving further exploration success both at the Galmoy Mine and on the substantial acreage covered by the company's seven prospecting licences in the Galmoy District.
